# tools

Repository tooling, tested like product code (`npx nx test tools`).

- `ai/sync.mts`: generates the tool-specific AI context files from `AGENTS.md` files and `ai/mcp-servers.json` (PRD section 10). Logic is exported (`syncAiContext`, `buildExpectedFiles`) and tested in `ai/sync.spec.mts` on a temporary directory.
- `lint/lint-rules.spec.mts`: regression tests of the ESLint rules that guard the architecture (module boundaries, Capacitor and browser globals only in the platform layer, `zod/mini`, no `any`, no `innerHTML`). When you change `eslint.config.mjs`, keep these tests green; when you add an architectural rule, add a case here.
- `docker/postgres-init/`: SQL run on the first start of the PostgreSQL volume.

Files are `.mts` and run directly with Node 24 (type stripping): only erasable TypeScript syntax, explicit `.mts` extensions in relative imports.
